name: Sanctuary Cap Cana, Adult All-Inclusive Resort
positioning: Adults-only, all-inclusive beach resort, officially Sanctuary Cap Cana, a Luxury Collection Resort, built to resemble a colonial Spanish castle town on a cliff by the ocean, inside the gated Cap Cana community in Punta Cana
best_for: Couples who want an adults-only, all-inclusive beach stay
Golfers who want to be close to Punta Espada Golf Club
Travelers who want a suite with a living room and terrace

facts.text: The resort is set along a stretch of white sand beach in the Dominican Republic.
The resort is 15 minutes from Punta Cana International Airport.
The resort is in Cap Cana, a private gated community inside Punta Cana.
Cap Cana is a gated area of 30,000 acres with oceanfront vistas and historic valley roads.
The resort's address is on Playa Juanillo in Cap Cana.
Cap Cana is home to Punta Espada Golf Club, which has oceanfront fairways.
All accommodations have a furnished living room and terrace.
Bathrooms have a separate shower and a jetted bathtub.
The minibar is replenished daily with water, beer, soft drinks and snacks.
The room rate typically includes meals, snacks, alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, entertainment and non-motorized water sports.
The Steakhouse is designed as a traditional Argentinian grill, with a cast iron and brick oven that uses wood and charcoal.

highlights.text: The resort resembles a colonial Spanish castle town perched on a cliff by the ocean.
Suites and villas are designed to complement the property's Spanish Colonial architecture.
Castle suite and Cap Cana Villa guests have butler service.
The spa combines hydro treatments and cutting-edge therapies.
Blue Marlin, the seafood restaurant, is perched on stilts overlooking the ocean.

considerations.text: Spa treatments, motorized water sports, tours and premium items may cost extra.
Connecting rooms are not available, and rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
